question.summary: Mathematics lacks a construction of nontrivial four-dimensional quantum Yang-Mills theory satisfying the official axioms together with a proof of a positive mass gap.
question.importance: The problem asks mathematics to construct the four-dimensional quantum gauge theory used in particle physics and derive its positive particle-mass scale from the axioms.
question.unresolved: Construct the theory on four-dimensional Euclidean space for every compact simple gauge group under the official axioms and prove a positive mass gap.

sourceRefs.locator: Sec. 4, ‘The Problem’ in the official Jaffe-Witten statement

claims.title: Clay continues to list the problem as unsolved
claims.text: The official Clay page says that experiments and simulations support a mass gap but no proof meeting the mathematical problem is known.

claims.title: A new preprint claims a four-dimensional construction
claims.text: Faizal and Shabir claim a reflection-positive SU(N) continuum construction with a mass gap. The paper is unrefereed, and the official problem remains listed as unsolved.

decisions.rationale: Status assessed against the archived statement in the 2026-08-31 primary-source audit; the evidence ledger lists the results considered.

cautions.label: Unreviewed claim
cautions.text: Do not mark the problem solved from arXiv:2606.19362. The claim has not passed journal or Clay review, and its SU(N) scope must be checked against the full official statement.
